import asyncio,hashlib,json,sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp
from devtools.models.interaction.usage import ModelUsage
from devtools.observability.usage import Attribution,UsageObservation,UsageWindow,report
from devtools.observability.usage.collection import reconcile,sum_usage
from devtools.observability.usage.storage import load,save,writer
from devtools.tools import ToolRunner
from apps.operator_dashboard.project import project
O=Path(__file__).parent; AT=Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-10-25T12:00:00Z');WINDOW=UsageWindow.rolling(AT)
def row(**changes):
 return replace(UsageObservation(timestamp=AT,backend='backend-A',provider='provider-A',model='literal-model',reasoning_effort='UNKNOWN',execution_profile='AUDIT_FIXTURE',invocation_id='invocation',thread_id='thread',turn_id='turn-A',response_id=None,usage=ModelUsage(input_tokens=10,output_tokens=2),source='INDEPENDENT_LITERAL',source_digest='digest-A',attribution=Attribution(project='literal'),completed=True),**changes)
def show(rows):
 v=report(tuple(rows),UsageWindow.rolling(Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-10-25T13:00:00Z')))
 return {k:v[k] for k in ['fresh_invocations','tokens','unknown_category_observations','conflicting_invocations_excluded','accepted','failed','outcome_unknown']}
async def main():
 out=[]
 known=row();unknown=row(invocation_id='other',thread_id='other',usage=ModelUsage(),source_digest='unknown')
 assert sum_usage((known.usage,unknown.usage)).input_tokens is None
 v=show([known,unknown]);assert v['tokens']['input_tokens']==10 and v['unknown_category_observations']['input_tokens']==1
 out.append(dict(case='disjoint_known_unknown',expected='Known subtotal10 plus one explicit unknown, never total10 for both',actual=v,defect=False))
 other=row(backend='backend-B',provider='provider-B',turn_id='turn-B',invocation_id='invocation-B',source_digest='digest-B')
 alias=row(turn_id=None,source_digest='alias-A')
 alone=show([known,alias]);together=show([known,alias,other])
 assert alone['conflicting_invocations_excluded']==0 and together['conflicting_invocations_excluded']==1
 out.append(dict(case='cross_provider_thread_alias',expected='Adding unrelated provider-B must not invalidate provider-A single-turn alias',input=[r.to_dict() for r in [known,alias,other]],alone=alone,actual=together,defect=True))
 r=row(granularity='RESPONSE',response_id='response-A');partial=replace(r,usage=ModelUsage(output_tokens=2),source_digest='partial')
 first=show([r,partial]);second=show([partial,r]);assert first['tokens']['input_tokens']==0 and second['tokens']['input_tokens']==10
 out.append(dict(case='duplicate_response_order',expected='Same response identity and compatible partial facts must not erase known usage depending on input order',input=[r.to_dict(),partial.to_dict()],known_then_partial=first,partial_then_known=second,defect=True))
 bad=replace(r,usage=ModelUsage(input_tokens=11),source_digest='contradictory');v=show([r,bad]);assert v['conflicting_invocations_excluded']==1
 out.append(dict(case='conflicting_known_tokens',expected='Conflict visible and excluded',actual=v,defect=False))
 accepted=row(completed=True,validated=True,accepted=True);failed=replace(accepted,completed=False,validated=False,accepted=False,failure_class='OBSERVED_FAILURE',source_digest='failure')
 v=show([accepted,failed]);assert v['accepted']==1 and v['failed']==0 and v['conflicting_invocations_excluded']==0
 out.append(dict(case='contradictory_outcomes',expected='Qualify terminal fact domains before interpreting incompatible-looking outcomes',input=[accepted.to_dict(),failed.to_dict()],actual=v,defect=False,disposition='Existing explicit accepted-first report precedence. B-0023 must qualify source/layer/acceptance-domain and progression; this synthetic combination alone does not prove same-domain production corruption.'))
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-usage-custody-') as directory:
  root=Path(directory);p=root/'ledger.json'
  with writer(p):
   save(p,(r,r,partial))
   try:
    with writer(p):raise AssertionError('Second writer entered')
   except FileExistsError:pass
  persisted=load(p);assert len(persisted)==2
  v=show(persisted)
  before=p.read_bytes();raw=json.loads(before);raw['observations'][0]['usage']['input_tokens']=99;p.write_text(json.dumps(raw),encoding='utf-8');altered=load(p)
  assert any(a.usage.input_tokens==99 for a in altered)
  out.append(dict(case='storage_duplicates_and_tamper_scope',expected='Exact duplicate dedup and writer contention refusal; schema-only local snapshot does not attest source truth',stored_rows=len(persisted),report=v,modified_valid_payload_loads=True,claim='Deliberately mutable metadata snapshot, not authenticated source-binding store. Existing B-0011 boundary; no demonstrated original corruption.',defect=False))
  p.write_text('{"schema":',encoding='utf-8')
  try:load(p)
  except Exception as error:corrupt=type(error).__name__
  else:raise AssertionError('Corrupt record accepted')
  out.append(dict(case='corrupt_storage',expected='Refuse corrupt durable snapshot',error=corrupt,defect=False))
  backlog=root/'docs/backlog';backlog.mkdir(parents=True);(backlog/'overview.md').write_text('# Backlog\n')
  worker=root/'.local/qwen-coding-worker/uncertain';worker.mkdir(parents=True)
  body=dict(schema='qwen-coding-loop-v2',disposition='TIMEOUT_COMPLETION_UNKNOWN_NO_RETRY',accepted=False,model_calls_attempted=1,usage_totals={'input_tokens':None},turns=[])
  (worker/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(body))
  snap=project(root);assert snap['workers'][0]['usage']['input_tokens'] is None and snap['workers'][0]['disposition']==body['disposition']
  assert 'measurement' not in snap['workers'][0]
  out.append(dict(case='operator_uncertain_worker',expected='Unknown tokens and completion uncertainty remain visible, not normalized framework Evidence by inference',actual=snap['workers'][0],defect=False))
 class EffectTool:
  def validate(self,args):assert args=='admitted'
  async def execute(self,args):effects.append('entered');raise asyncio.CancelledError()
 effects=[]
 try:await ToolRunner().execute(EffectTool(),'admitted')
 except asyncio.CancelledError:pass
 assert effects==['entered']
 out.append(dict(case='tool_cancel_after_entry',expected='Cancellation propagates without rollback or automatic completion record/retry',effects=effects,defect=False))
 (O/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(baseline='138adc07fa758032743cf5d79ff4b2fe0bb790cc',method='Independent literal metadata and temporary files; no original science or model execution',cases=out),indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 print(json.dumps([dict(case=r['case'],defect=r['defect']) for r in out],indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from probes import row,show
from devtools.agents.conversation import Conversation,ConversationMessage,ConversationMessageRole
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.models.interaction import InteractionSource
from devtools.execution import Runtime,InteractionAttemptCancelled
from devtools.observability.evidence import ExecutionInspector
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor
from devtools.observability.usage.storage import load,writer
O=Path(__file__).parent
async def main():
 rows=[]
 a=row(invocation_id='same-local-invocation',thread_id='thread-A')
 b=row(backend='backend-B',provider='provider-B',invocation_id='same-local-invocation',thread_id='thread-B',source_digest='B')
 v=show([a,b]);assert v['conflicting_invocations_excluded']==2
 rows.append(dict(case='cross_provider_invocation_alias',expected='Two providers may reuse their local invocation labels without conflict',actual=v,defect=True))
 from devtools.models.interaction.usage import ModelUsage
 from dataclasses import replace
 strongest=row(usage=ModelUsage(input_tokens=10,output_tokens=2))
 partial1=replace(strongest,usage=ModelUsage(reasoning_tokens=1),source_digest='reasoning1')
 partial2=replace(strongest,usage=ModelUsage(reasoning_tokens=2),source_digest='reasoning2')
 v=show([strongest,partial1,partial2]);assert v['conflicting_invocations_excluded']==0
 rows.append(dict(case='partial_turn_conflict_hidden_by_chosen_row',expected='Two incompatible known reasoning counts for the same invocation must remain conflicting even if the chosen more-complete row lacks reasoning',actual=v,inputs=[r.to_dict() for r in [strongest,partial1,partial2]],defect=True,owner='Same partial-observation reconciliation repair as response ordering; no third proposal'))
 entered=[]
 class Interrupted:
  source=InteractionSource('independent-interrupted-model')
  async def send(self,request):entered.append(str(self.source));raise asyncio.CancelledError()
 inspector=ExecutionInspector();conversation=Conversation.new()
 try:
  await Runtime(observer=inspector).send(conversation=conversation,interaction=Interrupted(),message=ConversationMessage.new('literal question',role=ConversationMessageRole.USER,source=InteractionSource('literal caller')))
 except asyncio.CancelledError:pass
 ids=inspector.attempt_ids();assert len(ids)==1
 evidence=inspector.get_evidence_for_attempt(ids[0]);assert isinstance(evidence[0].outcome,InteractionAttemptCancelled) and len(entered)==1
 rows.append(dict(case='runtime_cancel_after_model_entry',expected='Known fake entry and terminal cancellation, but no returned token usage or durable Evidence inferred',attempt=str(ids[0]),evidence=str(evidence[0].id),outcome=type(evidence[0].outcome).__name__,usage='UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO',live_model=False,defect=False))
 from apps.operator_dashboard.details import turn_detail
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-operator-join-') as directory:
  folder=Path(directory);turn=folder/'turn-01';turn.mkdir()
  (turn/'response.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(tool_calls=[dict(name='read_file',provider_call_id=None,arguments_json='{}')])));
  detail=turn_detail(folder,dict(number=1,disposition='CONTEXT_RETURNED'),raw=False)
  assert detail['proposal_correlation']=='MATCH'
  rows.append(dict(case='operator_missing_call_identity_matches',expected='Absent proposal identity and absent provider call identity must be NOT_ESTABLISHED, not a successful join',actual=detail['proposal_correlation'],stage_proposal_id=None,response_provider_call_id=None,response_tool_name='read_file',consumer='DashboardServer.detail -> run_detail -> turn_detail -> RunDetail proposal_correlation',defect=True))
 with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-usage-crash-') as directory:
  p=Path(directory)/'ledger.json'
  code="from pathlib import Path\nimport os\nfrom devtools.observability.usage.storage import writer\np=Path("+repr(str(p))+ ")\nwith writer(p):\n p.write_text('external-effect-observed',encoding='utf-8')\n print('AFTER_EFFECT_BEFORE_COMPLETION',flush=True)\n os._exit(9)\n"
  result=await CommandExecutor().execute(Command(sys.executable).args('-c',code).cwd(resolve_path(Path.cwd())))
  assert result.exit_code==9 and p.read_text()=='external-effect-observed' and p.with_suffix('.writer').is_dir()
  try:
   with writer(p):raise AssertionError('Unsafe retry admitted')
  except FileExistsError:pass
  rows.append(dict(case='abrupt_writer_exit_after_effect',expected='External effect remains; stale lease blocks retry rather than claiming no effect or auto-clearing',exit=result.exit_code,stdout=result.stdout.decode(),bytes=p.read_text(),lease_retained=True,automatic_retry=False,defect=False))
 (O/'extra-probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(cases=rows),indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
asyncio.run(main())
